entities.name: Q81K13
observations: Exact full-length sequence match to reviewed Bacillus anthracis UDP-N-acetylglucosamine 1-carboxyvinyltransferase 1 (EC 2.5.1.7).
Catalyzes transfer of an enolpyruvyl group from phosphoenolpyruvate to UDP-N-acetylglucosamine in peptidoglycan precursor biosynthesis.
Reference annotations place the protein in the cytoplasm and associate it with peptidoglycan biosynthesis.

entities.name: GO:0009252
observations: Peptidoglycan biosynthetic process; the exact-match reference protein is annotated to this process.
